faq.q: How do I install VN on Android?

It's free to install, and Play keeps it updated automatically. faq.q: VN vs CapCut: which is better?
faq.a: CapCut has more trending templates and AI tools. VN has a cleaner timeline that feels closer to desktop editors, and it suits people who edit clip by clip.

faq.q: What are the best VN export settings?
faq.a: For social media, export at 1080p and 30 fps with the default bitrate. Use 4K only if your footage was shot in 4K and you have the storage.
